panel.alt: Pell has returned down the ordinary service stair to the established LOWER pump-cabinet landing. He uses his retained key to remove the lamp-branch lock, then restores that same enclosed lamp switch. The domestic pump indicator remains lit. Above and beyond him, Aren, Sera and Rusk wait behind the closed UPPER guardrail, watching the corrected narrow cyan strip fall onto the guide pane while the exposed collar stays dark. The work shelf and stopped goods car are empty; the distant ray does not turn toward the collar.

observed: Same lower control, open lock/key, amber pump, three guarded upper observers, empty lower car, cyan guide band and unlit separate collar
not_claimed: Exact dark-hood slot optical ray geometry or directly observed fauna reaction
